batch: Classify the five held scholarship documents that remained outside derived publication-registry scopes
policy: These are document-scope judgments only. They do not certify completeness of object enumeration, endorse readings, or change text and media rights.

entries.basis: Archived Proceedings volume SHA-256 f34353aac187...; Schwab 1891, printed pp. 583-595. The opening at p. 584 states that the paper examines seven previously unpublished inscriptions, then presents them separately. This is an edition of multiple bowls rather than a thematic survey.

Researcher-supplied five-page article SHA-256 532e80b60b5e...; printed p. 242 says the paper presents one hitherto unpublished bowl from the Samir Dehay collection, designated SD34, and describes its fourteen-line text.

Archived 179-page dissertation SHA-256 8ae23ed1a2fd...; abstract and contents frame a sustained inquiry into who wrote the bowls, women as scribes/authors, the NFP style, and related social-historical interpretation. It is not organized as an edition or collection catalogue.

Archived complete book SHA-256 44e0ae8bc7ed...; contents and preface show an analytical introduction followed by a cross-publication catalogue of biblical quotations and a distribution table. Because the catalogue concerns one textual phenomenon across collections, rather than cataloguing a physical collection, the project vocabulary classifies it as a thematic study.

Researcher-supplied complete chapter SHA-256 b60b030f13d2..., printed pp. 3-48. The opening says it provides a broad overview of current research and proceeds from chronology, geography, language, contents and use to the social and cultural milieu; later sections survey publication history and major editions.
